name: I/O Configuration Persistence Across Verilog Source Edits
expectedBehaviors: Preserves assignments when port name, direction, and width remain unchanged
Detects newly added ports as Unassigned without wiping existing assignments
Removes deleted ports cleanly from active mappings
Flags direction-changed and width-invalidated ports as Invalid Assignment instead of silently discarding
Preserves prior assignments when a mid-edit syntax error temporarily yields 0 ports
